 43107:             return false;
 43108:         }
 43109:     }
 43110: 
 43111:     return false;
 43112: }

 43114: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_identifier(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index, CIrConstantValue* result)
 43115: {
 43116:     CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 43117:     if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) && (string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")) || string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("false"))))
 43118:     {
 43119:         *result = c_ir_constant_integer(builder->bool_type, string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("true")));
 43120:         return true;
 43121:     }
 43122:     if (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(builder->preprocess.dialect) && string_equal(c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token), S8("nullptr")))
 43123:     {
 43124:         *result = (CIrConstantValue){.type = builder->nullptr_type, .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER};
 43125:         return true;
 43126:     }
 43127:     CEntityId entity_id = c_ir_constant_entity_at(builder, token_index);
 43128:     if (entity_id.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
 43129:     {
 43130:         CEntity* entity = builder->parse.entities + entity_id.value;
 43131:         if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR || (entity->is_constexpr && entity->has_constant_value))
 43132:         {
 43133:             IrTypeId type = entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count ? builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value] : builder->s32_type;
 43134:             u64 value = entity->constant_value;
 43135:             if (entity->constant_is_negative)
 43136:             {
 43137:                 value = 0 - value;
 43138:             }
 43139:             *result = c_ir_constant_integer(type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->s32_type : type, value);
 43140:             return true;
 43141:         }
 43142:         // A function-local static is C_ENTITY_LOCAL with a symbol -- the
 43143:         // clinic macros write `.kwtuple = (&_kwtuple.ob_base.ob_base)` where
 43144:         // _kwtuple is exactly that -- and it folds like any file-scope
 43145:         // object.  An automatic local has no symbol and stays refused.
 43146:         bool static_local = entity->kind == C_ENTITY_LOCAL && builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 43147:         if ((entity->kind == C_ENTITY_OBJECT || static_local) && entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 43148:         {
 43149:             IrSymbolId symbol = builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value];
 43150:             IrTypeId type = builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value];
 43151:             IrType* type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type);
 43152:             if (type_value && type_value->layout.resolved)
 43153:             {
 43154:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
 43155:                     .type = type,
 43156:                     .symbol = symbol,
 43157:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE,
 43158:                 };
 43159:                 return true;
 43160:             }
 43161:         }
 43162:         if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_FUNCTION && entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
 43163:         {
 43164:             IrTypeId function_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value];
 43165:             IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, function_type);
 43166:             if (pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
 43167:             {
 43168:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
 43169:                     .type = pointer_type,
 43170:                     .symbol = builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value],
 43171:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER,
 43172:                 };
 43173:                 return result->symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
 43174:             }
 43175:         }
 43176:     }
 43177: 
 43178:     return false;
 43179: }

 43181: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_lvalue_field(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value, String8 name)
 43182: {
